title: How Education and Art Empower Afghan Girls
description: In this piece, EmpowerHer Creative Arts Workshop mentor and Afghan student-artist Sabira Hussaini reflects on how education and art empower Afghan girls. Through her painting Omulbanin: The Girl Who Dreamed of Harvard and her work with EmpowerHer, she honors lost dreams while inspiring girls to believe in their power to create change.
from: National Society of High School Scholars (NSHSS)
